description: Unit tests for the BaselineOptimizer class in the WebKitpy project, testing baseline optimization logic and internal methods.

classes.name: BaselineOptimizerTest
classes.description: Test suite for the BaselineOptimizer class, containing multiple test cases for baseline optimization scenarios.

methods.name: _assert_optimization
methods.description: Helper method to set up and verify baseline optimization results.

methods.name: test_linux_redundant_with_win
methods.description: Test that Linux baseline is redundant when Windows baseline exists.

methods.name: test_covers_mac_win_linux
methods.description: Test that an empty baseline covers Mac, Windows, and Linux.

methods.name: test_overwrites_root
methods.description: Test that root baseline is overwritten by specific platform baselines.

methods.name: test_no_new_common_directory
methods.description: Test that no new common directory is created when not needed.

methods.name: test_local_optimization
methods.description: Test local optimization by skipping intermediate platform baselines.

methods.name: test_local_optimization_skipping_a_port_in_the_middle
methods.description: Test skipping a port in the middle of a sequence during local optimization.

methods.name: test_baseline_redundant_with_root
methods.description: Test that platform baseline is redundant with root baseline.

methods.name: test_root_baseline_unused
methods.description: Test that unused root baseline is correctly ignored.

methods.name: test_root_baseline_unused_and_non_existant
methods.description: Test behavior when root baseline is unused and non-existent.

methods.name: test_virtual_root_redundant_with_actual_root
methods.description: Test virtual root baseline redundancy with actual root.

methods.name: test_virtual_root_redundant_with_ancestors
methods.description: Test virtual root baseline redundancy with ancestor baselines.

methods.name: test_virtual_root_not_redundant_with_ancestors
methods.description: Test that virtual root baseline is not redundant when ancestors differ.

methods.name: test_move_baselines
methods.description: Test internal method for moving baseline files between directories.

methods.name: test_move_baselines_skip_git_commands
methods.description: Test that moving baselines skips directories with git commands.
